name: WP AI Chat Widget Advanced
author: richiyali

sections.description:
WP AI Chat Widget Advanced adds a floating chat widget to your website.

Core free features:
* Floating site chat widget.
* Widget appearance settings.
* Optional JewelsStore hosted AI service connection for reply generation.
* Optional direct OpenAI API mode using the site owner’s own API key.
* Optional WhatsApp quick-contact button.
* Optional Meta WhatsApp Cloud webhook integration.
* Agent instructions and knowledge fields.
* Basic multilingual interface texts.
* Optional aggregate installation insights after explicit opt-in.
* Optional concise upgrade-aware assistant mode for the external AI service.
* Hosted AI allowance can be limited by your external JewelsStore service without disabling the free widget itself.

Premium features such as advanced analytics, conversation history dashboard, lead capture workflows, advanced automation, multi-agent tools, exports, and licensing are provided by a separate premium add-on and are not included in this free plugin.

External services

This plugin can connect to external services when you enable the related options in the plugin settings.

  1. JewelsStore hosted AI service

* What it is used for: generating chat replies when the AI reply mode is set to JewelsStore hosted AI.
* What data is sent: the visitor message, site URL, plugin slug, plugin version, and the configured runtime agent payload such as agent name, instructions, knowledge, and optional page context.
* When data is sent: when a site visitor submits a chat message and the JewelsStore hosted AI mode is enabled.
* Extra note: this hosted service may apply a hosted monthly reply allowance per site. If that allowance is reached, the free widget stays active and the site owner can continue with WhatsApp, direct OpenAI mode, or a premium hosted plan.
* Service provider: JewelsStore.
* Terms of use: https://jewelsstore.shop/terms-and-conditions/
* Privacy policy: https://jewelsstore.shop/privacy-policy/

  1. OpenAI API (direct mode)

* What it is used for: generating chat replies directly from the site when the AI reply mode is set to Direct OpenAI API.
* What data is sent: the visitor message and the configured runtime agent payload such as agent name, instructions, knowledge, and optional page context.
* When data is sent: when a site visitor submits a chat message and the site owner has chosen Direct OpenAI API mode.
* Service provider: OpenAI.
* Terms of use: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
* Privacy policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy/

  1. Meta / WhatsApp Cloud API

* What it is used for: receiving and sending WhatsApp messages through Meta when webhook integration is enabled and configured by the site owner.
* What data is sent: WhatsApp message payloads and outgoing reply messages to the Meta Graph API.
* When data is sent: only when the site owner enables Meta webhook mode and connects their Meta developer credentials.
* Service provider: Meta.
* Terms of service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
* Privacy policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

  1. JewelsStore installation insights service

* What it is used for: optionally refreshing aggregate installation insights shown inside the plugin settings page.
* What data is sent: site URL, administrator email, plugin slug, plugin version, WordPress version, PHP version, locale, timezone, server name, and a small diagnostics payload.
* When data is sent: only after the site owner explicitly enables the optional installation insights setting.
* Service provider: JewelsStore.
* Terms of use: https://jewelsstore.shop/terms-and-conditions/
* Privacy policy: https://jewelsstore.shop/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the jewelsstore-chat-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it from WordPress.org.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the WP AI Chat Widget Advanced admin menu.
  4. Configure the widget and, if desired, choose JewelsStore hosted AI, Direct OpenAI API, and/or Meta webhook integration.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin work without the premium add-on?

Yes. The free plugin works on its own.

Is an external service required?

No. The widget can be displayed without it. Automatic AI replies require either JewelsStore hosted AI mode or Direct OpenAI API mode to be enabled and configured.

Can I upgrade later?

Yes. Advanced features are available through the separate premium add-on.

Does the free version block basic chat help?

No. The free version can be configured to keep replies concise and mention upgrades when relevant, but it should still provide basic help.

Can I protect my hosted API budget in the free version?

Yes. The free widget can stay usable while the optional JewelsStore hosted AI service applies a monthly hosted reply allowance per site. Site owners can also switch to Direct OpenAI API mode to use their own API key.

1.6.2

  • Rebranded the public plugin name to WP AI Chat Widget Advanced.
  • Updated the readme display name and stable tag.
  • Kept the existing plugin slug and text domain for WordPress.org compatibility.

screenshots.caption: Premium trial activation screen. After installing the separate premium add-on, site owners can start the free 12-day trial to test premium features on their own website.
Premium licence activation area. Site owners who already purchased a premium licence can paste the key received by email and activate their premium access from this section.

Premium workspace overview. This screen introduces the advanced premium area with multi-agent support, widget styles, conversation history, exports, automations, fallback rules, analytics, schedules, page targeting, WooCommerce and CRM integrations, webhooks, multilingual options, smart triggers, lead capture, admin alerts, and saved reply templates.

Premium add-on requirement notice. This screen explains that the free WP AI Chat Widget Advanced works on its own, while premium features require the separate premium add-on downloaded from the official website.
Official premium access page. This screen shows where site owners can review the premium information and follow the official website path for premium access and licence purchase details.
